<template>
  <el-dialog v-model="visible" title="删除网络" width="30%" @close="closeDialog">
    <el-form :model="form">
      <el-form-item label="选择网络" required>
        <el-select v-model="form.networkName" placeholder="请选择要删除的网络" style="width: 100%">
          <el-option
              v-for="name in Object.keys(networksRef?.value?.networks || {})"
              :key="name"
              :label="name"
              :value="name"
          />
        </el-select>
      </el-form-item>
    </el-form>

    <template #footer>
      <el-button type="danger" @click="submitDelete">删除</el-button>
      <el-button @click="closeDialog">取消</el-button>
    </template>

    <!-- 隐藏挂载子组件，用于访问其数据 -->
    <DockerNetworks ref="networksRef" style="display: none" />
  </el-dialog>
</template>


<!-- DeleteNetworkDialog.vue -->
<script setup>
import { ref, defineExpose, onMounted } from 'vue'
import axios from 'axios'
import { ElMessage } from 'element-plus'
import DockerNetworks from './DockerNetworks.vue' // 引入子组件

const visible = ref(false)
const form = ref({ networkName: '' })

const networksRef = ref(null) // 用于访问 DockerNetworks 组件

const openDialog = async () => {
  form.value.networkName = ''
  visible.value = true

  // 调用子组件刷新网络列表
  if (networksRef.value) {
    await networksRef.value.fetchNetworks()
  }
}

const closeDialog = () => {
  visible.value = false
  form.value.networkName = ''
}

const submitDelete = async () => {
  if (!form.value.networkName) {
    ElMessage.warning('请选择网络名称')
    return
  }

  try {
    await axios.delete(`http://localhost:8081/network/delete/${form.value.networkName}`)
    ElMessage.success('删除成功')
    await networksRef.value.fetchNetworks() // 更新子组件的网络数据
    form.value.networkName = ''
  } catch (err) {
    ElMessage.error('删除失败')
  }
}

// 向父组件暴露方法
defineExpose({
  openDialog
})
</script>
